_how: Chosen before test scoring. turn: on pooled train out-of-fold + val window scores (caveman vs normal); monitor = best F1, penalty = lowest threshold with precision >= 0.97, p95 = lowest threshold with precision >= 0.95. rollout (score = mean turn probability): from val rollouts; monitor = 0.5 (middle of the gap between normal and caveman rollouts), penalty = just above the highest-scoring val normal rollout.
